text.en: BEVFormer is row 12 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Vision area.
text.zh: BEVFormer 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 12 行，所属领域为“视觉”。

text.en: The annual table associates BEVFormer with “BEVFormer: Learning Bird's-Eye-View Representation from Multi-Camera Images via Spatiotemporal Transformers”.
text.zh: 年度表把 BEVFormer 与论文《BEVFormer: Learning Bird's-Eye-View Representation from Multi-Camera Images via Spatiotemporal Transformers》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Zhiqi Li, Wenhai Wang, Hongyang Li, Jifeng Dai”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Zhiqi Li（官方页拼写）、Wenhai Wang（官方页拼写）、Hongyang Li（官方页拼写）、Jifeng Dai（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Zhiqi Li, Wenhai Wang, Hongyang Li, Jifeng Dai”。
